name: Louis Brasseur
want: make each side understand the other before it is too late
secret: The commissioners told him to soften what the Lakota say in council, and he has been doing it.
voice: Lakota and English and French, always choosing his words.
description: The son of a French trader and an Oglala woman, who interprets at Fort Laramie and comes to the camp as a relative and a messenger.
appearance: A frock coat over a beaded vest, moccasins, a notebook.
